summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 35.6 minutes, including 5 compute-bound tasks. bottlenecks_identified: The compute-bound duration leaders in the supplied ranking were Live ARC adapter-withheld cumulative discovery session at 31.76 minutes, V636 source delta and exact execution contract at 0.96 minutes, and Bounded local vLLM Qwen3 XML tool-parser canary at 0.9 minutes; no data available this milestone identifies their responsible internal phases.
The Live ARC adapter-withheld cumulative discovery session concentrated 31.76 minutes of the 35.6-minute milestone window in one compute-bound path.
The disk-mtime reconstruction has no task-owned phase boundaries or progress receipts, so it ranks the critical path without explaining why it was slow.
Task-window GPU, process, model-concurrency, and runner-selection attribution is absent, preventing a definitive accelerator-efficiency or dispatch diagnosis.
improvements_suggested: Add task-owned phase timers and progress checkpoints to the Live ARC path so its dominant phase can be bounded, cached, or resumed.
Capture GPU samples inside each compute-bound task window with process and model attribution rather than relying on an uncorrelated monitor snapshot.
Emit model-concurrency and runner-selection receipts at dispatch, and select DualGPURunner only for declared parallel multi-model work.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument and checkpoint every phase of the Live ARC compute path.
Attach task-correlated GPU and process telemetry to every compute-bound artifact.
Record model concurrency and runner choice for every compute dispatch.
meta_reflection: The disk-mtime fallback is sufficient to rank durations but not to explain the critical path. The 0% GPU snapshot, together with the locked false task-idle flag, does not establish inefficient compute execution, and no data available this milestone shows a parallel multi-model launch. A nonzero savings estimate would exceed the evidence, so the estimate remains 0 until a measured counterfactual exists.
